zh: 汉阳大学（Hanyang University）始建于1939年，主校区位于韩国首尔特别市，另有安山校区，是韩国顶尖的私立综合研究型大学，被誉为“韩国的MIT”，以工科实力强劲闻名全球。学校在工程技术、计算机科学、电子信息、材料科学、医学、商科等领域均处于韩国领先水平，学科体系齐全，科研经费充足，与现代、三星、LG等韩国龙头企业保持深度产学研合作。汉阳大学秉持“爱与真理”的校训，重视实践创新与人才培养，毕业生在韩国科技、工业、商界等领域占据重要地位。作为韩国国际化程度极高的高校，该校与世界众多一流大学建立学术交流，在亚洲乃至全球工程教育领域都具有重要影响力。
en: Hanyang University was founded in 1939, with its main campus in Seoul, South Korea, and another campus in Ansan. It is a top private comprehensive research university in South Korea, known as the 'MIT of Korea' and famous worldwide for its strong engineering strength. The university ranks among the top in South Korea in engineering, computer science, electronic information, material science, medicine, business and other fields, with a complete discipline system and sufficient research funds. It maintains in-depth industry-university-research cooperation with South Korean leading enterprises such as Hyundai, Samsung and LG. Adhering to the motto 'Love and Truth', Hanyang University attaches great importance to practical innovation and talent training. Its graduates occupy important positions in South Korea's technology, industry, business and other fields. As a highly internationalized university in South Korea, it has established academic exchanges with many world-class universities and has an important influence in the field of engineering education in Asia and even the world.
